purpose: Concede a condition while maintaining the main judgment.
keywords: Plain clause / N / な-adjective + にせよ / にしろ
Even if we are in a hurry, safety checks are necessary.
Even as a joke, that way of speaking is not acceptable.
Even though it failed, making the attempt has value.
formation: Plain clause / N / な-adjective + にせよ / にしろ
restrictions: Often means even if or granted that; noun attachment can also include である.
mistake: The concession does not cancel the main requirement.
